# SwanDigitals llms.txt

> SwanDesk by SwanDigitals is an AI-powered customer support platform built specifically for Indian businesses. It brings WhatsApp, email, web chat, Instagram, Telegram, and phone support into a single unified inbox — so support teams stop switching between tabs and start resolving conversations faster.
>
> SwanDesk is not a chatbot builder. It is a full helpdesk platform with AI already wired in. The AI suggests replies, auto-resolves repetitive questions, tags conversations, and hands off to human agents when it can't answer — with full context, no dead ends.
>
> The platform supports 6 Indian languages natively (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Kannada) — not through translation APIs, but through purpose-built NLU models. Voice AI handles inbound phone calls in these languages with sub-500ms latency using Retell AI (cloud) or Whisper + Coqui TTS (on-premise).
>
> For banks, NBFCs, and healthcare companies that need data sovereignty, SwanDesk offers a fully air-gapped on-premise deployment — Ollama LLM, Whisper STT, Asterisk SIP — no external API calls, no internet dependency. Built for DPDP 2023 compliance and RBI guidelines.
>
> Pricing is flat monthly — not per conversation, not per seat. Teams go live in about 7 days with hands-on onboarding support.
>
> SwanDigitals is founded and run by Abhishek Ambad, based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Features (Deep Dive)

- [Voice AI](https://swandigitals.com/features/voice-ai): Phone support in 6 Indian languages. Sub-500ms voice latency. Works with Retell AI (cloud) or Whisper + Coqui TTS (on-prem). Handles calls, answers queries, routes to agents.
- [Conversational AI](https://swandigitals.com/features/conversational-ai): Context-aware AI that reads full conversation history. Suggests replies, auto-resolves FAQs, handles follow-ups. Not keyword matching — actual comprehension.
- [NLU Engine](https://swandigitals.com/features/nlu): Natural Language Understanding purpose-built for Indian languages and Hinglish. Intent detection, entity extraction, sentiment analysis.
- [Analytics](https://swandigitals.com/features/analytics): Dashboard covering response times, resolution rates, AI automation rate, agent performance, CSAT, conversation volume trends.

## Solutions by Industry

- [Customer Service](https://swandigitals.com/solutions/customer-service): Unified inbox for support teams. AI handles repetitive tickets. Live agent handoff with full context. Multi-channel (WhatsApp, email, web chat, Instagram, Telegram).
- [Banking & BFSI](https://swandigitals.com/solutions/banking): Air-gapped on-premise deployment for banks and NBFCs. KYC automation, account inquiries, loan status. RBI and DPDP 2023 compliance ready. No external API dependencies.
- [Healthcare](https://swandigitals.com/solutions/healthcare): Patient support, appointment scheduling, lab report queries, insurance verification — all with data sovereignty and HIPAA-aligned security.
- [IT Helpdesk](https://swandigitals.com/solutions/it-helpdesk): Automate password resets, software access requests, VPN issues, and IT ticket triage. Integrates with existing ITSM tools.
- [Retail & E-commerce](https://swandigitals.com/solutions/retail): Order tracking, return requests, product recommendations, cart recovery. Connects with Shopify, WooCommerce.
- [Sales & Lead Capture](https://swandigitals.com/solutions/sales): Website chat widget captures leads, AI qualifies them, routes to the right sales rep. CRM sync with HubSpot, Zoho.
- [Employee Experience](https://swandigitals.com/solutions/employee-experience): Internal support for HR queries, onboarding, policy questions, IT issues — accessible via Slack, Teams, or intranet.

## Competitor Comparisons

- [vs Kore.ai](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-kore): SwanDesk offers flat pricing, setup in days (not months), and true on-premise — not dedicated VPC.
- [vs Yellow.ai](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-yellow): Simpler to use, no usage-based pricing, local Indian team with Indian support hours.
- [vs Haptik](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-haptik): Full platform vs chatbot widget. On-premise option. No per-conversation billing.
- [vs Intercom](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-intercom): Built for India — Indian languages, UPI integrations, DPDP compliance. Flat pricing vs Intercom's seat-based model.
- [vs Zendesk](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-zendesk): AI-first vs traditional helpdesk. Native WhatsApp Business API. On-premise option for regulated industries.
- [vs Kasisto](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-kasisto): Affordable banking AI with native voice capabilities and Indian language support.
- [vs Gupshup](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-gupshup): Full support platform vs messaging API. SwanDesk includes inbox, AI, analytics — not just message delivery.
- [vs IBM Watson](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-ibm): Faster deployment, lower cost, purpose-built for Indian market vs enterprise-scale IBM.
- [vs Pega](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-pega): Lightweight, quick-deploy alternative to Pega's heavy enterprise platform.
- [vs Drift](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-drift): Full customer support vs sales-focused chat. Indian language support. On-premise option.
- [vs Verloop](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-verloop): True on-premise deployment, broader language support, flat pricing model.
- [vs Personetics](https://swandigitals.com/compare/vs-personetics): Banking AI with native voice in Indian languages, on-premise deployment, and India-specific compliance.
